text:
The results of two tests on substance G are listed.
●
A flame test produces a yellow flame.
●
Substance G is added to aqueous sodium hydroxide and powdered aluminium and
warmed carefully. A gas is given off which turns damp red litmus paper blue.
What is G?
A
potassium chloride
B
potassium nitrate
C
sodium chloride
D
sodium nitrate
subject: Chemistry
